decisions.reason: The firm has already withdrawn two similar low-pile carpets, so collection rotation is a real risk, but its own product page and the sunk investment in the design still favour persisting a while longer.
The hand-knotted wool silk carpet embodies the craftsmanship and fine materials the firm publicly promotes, and the sourcing investment and that visible commitment argue for persistence.
The corner bench extends the established furniture range for residential and hospitality projects, and its development investment justifies giving it more time.
As a multi-model chair line with substantial tooling and design investment that is central to the firm's seating offer, management will strongly persist with it.
